title: Formal BDD/SMT query equivalence and semantic loss calculus
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; canonical ROBDD equivalence solving and witness synthesis remain open implementation gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Canonical Reduced Ordered Binary Decision Diagram (ROBDD) builder over atomic search predicates, field scopes and MeSH explosion trees
open_gates: Define SemanticRelation, CounterexampleWitness, and QueryEquivalenceProof contracts in crates/evidence-search-contracts/src/query.rs and crates/searchright-contracts/src/lib.rs.
Implement canonical Reduced Ordered Binary Decision Diagram (ROBDD) arena with Shannon reduction and field/explosion/proximity domain subsumption axioms in crates/evidence-search-core/src/lib.rs.
Implement prove_translation_equivalence and lexicographically minimal counterexample witness document synthesis across PubMed, Ovid MEDLINE, and Scopus in crates/evidence-search-core/src/compiler.rs.
Enforce fail-closed recall narrowing validation in crates/searchright-validation/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright/src/engine.rs with differential compiler test suites.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
